# Modules and the Filesystem
Rust's module system organizes code into distinct namespaces and controls privacy.

### The Modern Module Mapping

In modern Rust (2018/2021/2024 editions), declaring `mod network;` in `src/main.rs` resolves to `src/network.rs` or `src/network/mod.rs`.

```rust
// In src/network.rs
pub fn connect() {
    println!("Connecting to network host...");
}
```
